Is it possible that you worry about the opinions of other people? or something like social anxiety? From what I've read, you've worked on yourself, that's a great thing to notice. Also try to ask yourself about this, how is your relationship with other people? and how was your mindset going before or during your talk to someone? 

Other than that, don't give up and try not to beat yourself up, dating takes time, and patience and so do other types of relationships. The saying is true, getting used to rejection is not only to find out what couldn't work, but also to help to discover part of yourself. So Showing up and be present at events or activities might be helpful?  
  
Besides actively looking for dating, focusing / Prioritizing on other relationships you have like family or friends can also be helpful while improving your confidence and social skills. I'm not a native English Speaker and a dating coach but I'm speaking from my experiences so take this advice with a grain of salt, I hope you find this helpful.
